about: Official parking / entrance / gate / kiosk / boat ramp / trailhead point layers for US wildlife areas (and later state parks), from the outside research bot's round 3 (KPC_Round3_WMA.xlsx, Oct 25 2026). Read by .github/scripts/kpc_us_access.py. Append new layers; a layer that stops answering is skipped. Oct 25 PM: + CA State Parks parking + entry points, VA DCR facilities (parking only, by place), VA DWR river accesses, UT UGRC boat ramps + trailheads (by place) from the good bot (tested by chat 2). AZ 'Freedom 250' trailheads NOT added: the layer says Arizona State Parks but sits on a BLM account. Oct 26: + round 2 (HQ [USE] lines, 28 layers in TN MT WY VA AZ KS NM IN NC NV LA AK ND); mixed-owner statewide ramp layers by place only; SKIPPED Utah Walk-In Access (private landowner names), Hawaii parking inventory (licence 'For Review Only'), SD (login). Oct 26: CANADA added (st = CA-XX): kpc_us_access.py now also builds data/access/CA-XX.json from parkinfo/CA.json + the Canada key's outlines (canada-bounds + cache/ca CA-ALL). First layers from the parking explorer: BC rec trailheads, Ontario MNRF fishing access + OTN access points, Cataraqui + Niagara CA launches/entrances, Grey County parking + forest entrances, SK boat ramps, Parks Canada trail access (draft). Oct 26 night: + Parks Canada open data Facilities - Point and Facilities - Components (parking lots are a component type, coded; the bot now reads code lists).
